$$

$$

$$
p _ {\ell} ^ {m} (x) \equiv (- 1) ^ {m} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {m / 2} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {m} p _ {\ell} (x),
$$

$$
p _ {\ell} (x) \equiv \frac {1}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell},
$$

$$
Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (\theta , \phi) = (- 1) ^ {\ell} \sqrt {\frac {2 \ell + 1}{4 \pi (2 \ell) !}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi} p _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (\cos \theta),
$$

$$
p _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (x) = \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell / 2} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell} p _ {\ell} (x) = \frac {1}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell / 2} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2 \ell} \left(x ^ {2} - 1\right) ^ {\ell},

其中( $\left( x ^ { 2 } - 1 \right) ^ { \ell } = x ^ { 2 \ell } + a x ^ { 2 \ell - 1 } + b x ^ { 2 \ell - 2 } + \cdot \cdot \cdot + 1$ $a , b , \cdots$ ..是常数.

$$
p _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (x) = \frac {(2 \ell) !}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell / 2},
$$

$$
Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (\theta , \phi) = (- 1) ^ {\ell} \sqrt {\frac {2 \ell + 1}{4 \pi (2 \ell) !}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} l \phi} \frac {(2 \ell) !}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} (\sin \theta) ^ {\ell} = A (\sin \theta) ^ {\ell} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi},
$$

$$

$$

$$

$$
p _ {3} ^ {2} (x) = \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2} p _ {3} (x),
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} p _ {3} (x) = \frac {1}{8 \times 3 !} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {3} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {3} \\ = \frac {1}{4 8} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2} \left[ 6 x (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {2} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{8} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} \left[ \left(x ^ {2} - 1\right) ^ {2} + 4 x ^ {2} \left(x ^ {2} - 1\right) \right] \\ = \frac {1}{8} \left[ 4 x (x ^ {2} - 1) + 8 x (x ^ {2} - 1) + 8 x ^ {3} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} (5 x ^ {3} - 3 x). \\ \end{array}

困此

$$
p _ {3} ^ {2} (x) = \frac {1}{2} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2} \left(5 x ^ {3} - 3 x\right)
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = \frac {1}{2} (1 - x ^ {2}) \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} (1 5 x ^ {2} - 3) \\ = \frac {1}{2} (1 - x ^ {2}) \times 3 0 x \\ = 1 5 x \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
Y _ {3} ^ {2} (\theta , \phi) = \sqrt {\frac {7}{4 \pi \times 5 !}} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} \times 1 5 \cos \theta \sin^ {2} \theta ,
$$

$$
\frac {\partial Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\partial \theta} = A \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi} \ell (\sin \theta) ^ {\ell - 1} \cos \theta ,
$$

$$

$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\partial \theta}\right) = \sin \theta \left(- \ell \sin \theta Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} + \ell \cos \theta \frac {\ell \cos \theta Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\sin \theta}\right) \\ = \left(\ell^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta - \ell \sin^ {2} \theta\right) Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}, \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\partial \varphi^ {2}} = - l ^ {2} Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\partial \theta}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\partial \varphi^ {2}} = \left(\ell^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta - \ell \sin^ {2} \theta - \ell^ {2}\right) Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} \\ = - \ell (\ell + 1) \sin^ {2} \theta Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以 $Y _ { \ell } ^ { \ell }$ 满足角方程 (4.18).

$$

$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial Y _ {3} ^ {2}}{\partial \theta}\right) = B \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(2 \sin^ {2} \theta \cos^ {2} \theta - \sin^ {4} \theta\right) \\ = B \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta (4 \sin \theta \cos^ {3} \theta - 4 \sin^ {3} \theta \cos \theta - 4 \sin^ {3} \theta \cos \theta) \\ = 4 B \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin^ {2} \theta \cos \theta (\cos^ {2} \theta - 2 \sin^ {2} \theta) \\ = 4 \left(\cos^ {2} \theta - 2 \sin^ {2} \theta\right) Y _ {3} ^ {2}. \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} Y _ {3} ^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} = - 4 Y _ {3} ^ {2}, \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial Y _ {3} ^ {2}}{\partial \theta}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} Y _ {3} ^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} = 4 \left(\cos^ {2} \theta - 2 \sin^ {2} \theta\right) Y _ {3} ^ {2} - 4 Y _ {3} ^ {2} = - 1 2 \sin^ {2} \theta Y _ {3} ^ {2}.
$$

又

$$
\ell = 3, - \ell (\ell + 1) \sin^ {2} \theta Y _ {3} ^ {2} = - 1 2 \sin^ {2} \theta Y _ {3} ^ {2},
$$

所以 $Y _ { 3 } ^ { 2 }$ 满足角方程

$$
\sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial Y _ {3} ^ {2}}{\partial \theta}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} Y _ {3} ^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} = - \ell (\ell + 1) \sin^ {2} \theta Y _ {3} ^ {2}.

$$

$$
\left. \left[ \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell - n} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell} \right] \left[ \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell^ {\prime} + n - 1} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell^ {\prime}} \right] \right| _ {- 1} ^ {1} = 0.

即 $\ell \neq \ell ^ { \prime }$ 时，

$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} P _ {\ell} (x) P _ {\ell} ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm {d} x = 0,

当 $\ell = \ell ^ { \prime }$ 时，由上面知

$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} P _ {\ell} (x) P _ {\ell} ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{(2 ^ {\ell} \ell !) ^ {2}} (- 1) ^ {\ell} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2 \ell} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell} \mathrm {d} x,
$$

其中

$$
\begin{array}{l} (- 1) ^ {\ell} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2 \ell} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell} \mathrm {d} x = (- 1) ^ {\ell} (2 \ell)! \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (x ^ {2} - 1) ^ {\ell} \mathrm {d} x \\ = 2 (2 \ell)! \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell} \mathrm {d} x. \\ \end{array}
$$

令 $x = \cos \theta$ ，则 $1 - x ^ { 2 } = \sin ^ { 2 } \theta , \mathrm { d } x = - \sin \theta \mathrm { d } \theta$ ，完成积分

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {\pi / 2} ^ {0} (\sin \theta) ^ {2 \ell} (- \sin \theta) \mathrm {d} \theta \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi / 2} (\sin \theta) ^ {2 \ell + 1} \mathrm {d} \theta \\ = \frac {2 \times 4 \times 6 \times \cdots \times 2 \ell}{1 \times 3 \times 5 \times \cdots \times (2 \ell + 1)} \\ = \frac {\left(2 ^ {\ell} \ell !\right) ^ {2}}{1 \times 2 \times 3 \times \cdots \times (2 \ell + 1)} \\ = \frac {\left(2 ^ {\ell} \ell !\right) ^ {2}}{(2 \ell + 1) !}. \\ \end{array}

$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \left[ P _ {\ell} (x) \right] ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{(2 ^ {\ell} \ell !) ^ {2}} 2 (2 \ell)! \frac {(2 ^ {\ell} \ell !) ^ {2}}{(2 \ell + 1) !} = \frac {2}{2 \ell + 1}.

$$
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} P _ {\ell} (x) P _ {\ell^ {\prime}} (x) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{2 \ell + 1} \delta_ {\ell \ell^ {\prime}}.

# 习题 4.9

(a) 根据定义(方程 (4.46))，构造 $n _ { 1 } \left( x \right)$ 和 $n _ { 2 } \left( x \right)$ 0  
(b) $x \ll 1$ 时，采用正弦和余弦函数将 $n _ { 1 } \left( x \right)$ 和 $n _ { 2 } \left( x \right)$ 展开给出近似公式验证它们在原点处趋于发散.

解答 (叫方程 (4 .46)

$$
n _ {\ell} (x) \equiv - (- x) ^ {\ell} \left(\frac {1}{x} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell} \frac {\cos x}{x},
$$

所以

$$
n _ {1} (x) = - (- x) \left(\frac {1}{x} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) \frac {\cos x}{x} = - \frac {\cos x}{x ^ {2}} - \frac {\sin x}{x},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} n _ {2} (x) = - (- x) ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{x} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {2} \frac {\cos x}{x} \\ = - x ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{x} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) \left[ \frac {1}{x} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} \left(\frac {\cos x}{x}\right) \right] \\ = - x \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} \left(\frac {1}{x} \cdot \frac {- \cos x - x \sin x}{x ^ {2}}\right) \\ = x \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} \left(\frac {\cos x + x \sin x}{x ^ {3}}\right) \\ = x \left(\frac {x ^ {4} \cos x - 2 x ^ {3} \sin x - x ^ {3} \sin x - 3 x ^ {2} \cos x}{x ^ {6}}\right) \\ = - \frac {3}{x ^ {2}} \sin x - \left(\frac {3}{x ^ {3}} - \frac {1}{x}\right) \cos x \\ = x \left(\frac {x ^ {4} \cos x - 2 x ^ {3} \sin x - x ^ {3} \sin x - 3 x ^ {2} \cos x}{x ^ {6}}\right) \\ = - \frac {3}{x ^ {2}} \sin x - \left(\frac {3}{x ^ {3}} - \frac {1}{x}\right) \cos x. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) $x \ll 1$ 时， $\sin x \approx x , \cos x \approx 1$ ，所以

$$
n _ {1} (x) \approx - \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} - 1, \quad n _ {2} (x) \approx - \frac {3}{x} - \frac {3}{x ^ {3}} + \frac {1}{x}.
$$

在原点处 $x \to 0$ 时， $n _ { 1 } \left( x \right)$ 和 $n _ { 2 } \left( x \right)$ 均趋于无穷大.

# 习题 4.10

(a) 验证在 $V \left( r \right) = 0$ 和 $\ell = 1$ 情况下 $A r j _ { 1 } \left( k r \right)$ 满足径向方程.   
(b) $\ell = 1$ 时，用图解法确定无限深球势阱允许的能级.证明:对于较大的 $N$

有 $E _ { N 1 } \approx \left( { \hbar ^ { 2 } \pi ^ { 2 } } / { 2 m a ^ { 2 } } \right) ( N + 1 / 2$ $\left( N + 1 / 2 \right) ^ { 2 }$ .提示首先证明 $j _ { 1 } \left( x \right) = 0 \Rightarrow x = \tan x$ 在同一张图中画出 $x$ 和 $\tan x$ ，找出其交点的位置.

解答 (a) 径向方程为

$$
- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} u}{\mathrm {d} r ^ {2}} + \left[ V + \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\ell (\ell + 1)}{r ^ {2}} \right] u = E u.
$$
